title: Navigating the functionalization of unactivated alkenes via visible light photocatalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,6726-6806
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00181A, Review Article
Guang-Mei Cao, Si-Shun Yan, Lei Song, Yuan-Xu Jiang, Tian-Yu Gao, Zhen Chen, Wei Zhang, Jian-Heng Ye, Da-Gang Yu
Direct functionalization of unactivated alkenes via visible-light photocatalysis has emerged as a highly effective strategy for the rapid construction of multi-functional, complex molecular architectures from simple, abundant chemicals.
